title: Weapon
description: A melee weapon, per docs/09-combat.md. The properties here are the ones the parity contract rests on: reach decides whether you hit before being hit, weight decides what a swing costs you, and stagger is what keeps a crowd off you. A new weapon is a JSON entry with zero code.

id.description: Stable namespaced id. Permanent once shipped.

extends.description: Id of another weapon to inherit from.

category.description: Matches an affix's appliesTo. Only melee exists in Milestone 1; docs/09's ranged half is Milestone 2.

reach.description: Metres. docs/09: 'a spear outranges a knife and that matters more than damage' -- reach decides both who connects first and how much of a bite risk a connect carries.

damage.description: Applied to the body part struck, against the pools in a zombie's `body`. Never shown to the player (docs/01#4).

weight.description: Kilograms. Drives stamina cost per swing, so the heavy option is not free.

staggerPower.description: docs/09: 'blunt weapons stagger better; blades kill faster.' Stagger is the survival mechanic in a crowd, because a staggered zombie is not grabbing you.

noise.description: Emitted on connect. docs/03's table puts a melee connect at 8, blunt louder than blade -- about 11 m, which draws the neighbours and not the block.

windupTicks.description: Ticks at 20 Hz before the swing resolves. An interruptible window.

recoverTicks.description: Ticks after it resolves. Also interruptible -- docs/09: being caught in recovery is how melee kills you.
